name: capacity-map
title: Capacity map
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A zone accordion of slots arranged in space, linked to a table: shared highlight, a detail popover, extensible statuses, and a demand preview that discards without saving.

files.content:
/** Shared tone names. Host tokens only — no colors. */

export type StatusTone = "neutral" | "accent" | "warning" | "critical" | "info" | "positive"

meta.descriptionEs: Zonas en acordeón con cupos acomodados en el espacio, enlazados a una tabla: resaltado cruzado, popover de detalle, estados extensibles y una previsión de demanda que se descarta sin guardar.

examples.title: Mapa de cupos
examples.description: Zonas, pasillos, resaltado cruzado con la tabla y una previsión de demanda que se descarta.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Quinientos cupos y un nombre largo.

api.name: zones
api.description: Zones, groups and slots. Capacity defaults to the slot count.

api.name: statuses
api.description: Extends the built-in free, occupied, special and exceeded states.

api.name: highlightedId
api.description: Slot id highlighted from the map or the table.

api.name: onHighlight
api.description: Called on hover or focus. Pass null when the pointer leaves.

api.name: simulate
api.description: Shows a demand slider. The fill is a preview; Discard resets it. Nothing is saved.

api.name: layout
api.description: Aisle is two facing rows with a named rule. Wrap fits a narrow panel. List is the text alternative.

docs: Clean-room capacity map. Shadcn Studio Pro (Datatable Advanced 08, announced as Parking Sessions) was not purchased, fetched, or ported. No source, sample rows, icons, screenshots, or assets were copied, and the fixtures are not a parking lot. Colors come from the host shadcn tokens. The table, or the list layout, is the accessible source; highlight uses a ring, not color alone. The demand preview never persists. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has.
